heic2any 0.0.4
https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any

`heic2any.min.js` is the published build, byte for byte. It is a wrapper, and
what it wraps is libheif compiled to JavaScript with Emscripten, together with
the HEVC decoder libde265. Three licences therefore apply to the one file.

The wrapper is used, not modified, and is never passed through esbuild: it is
loaded at run time by web/assets/js/import/heif-worker.js and stays a separate
file, relinkable against another build of libheif without rebuilding anything
here. That is LGPL-3.0 section 4 - a work that *uses* the library - which is
what lets this GPL-3.0-or-later project carry it. Bundling it into
web/assets/app.js would end that and is the one thing not to do with it.
